scope: Every application UI route in the application map, plus Help and AI Coach Requests; valid record fixtures, security forms, and review flows.

fixed.problem: Fixed scrolling body starts below viewport-fixed header controls on touch screens, leaving the controls outside body bounds.
fixed.change: Use document scrolling at mobile widths and on coarse-pointer touch screens, including wide landscape; preserve fine-pointer desktop behavior.
fixed.limitation: The original device-specific invisible-header paint failure was not reproduced in current desktop WebKit.

fixed.problem: Sticky progress and Inbox controls can overlap fixed account, role-preview, or unlock banners.
fixed.change: Measure the complete shell stack for every role and use it for sticky offsets and anchor spacing.

fixed.problem: Mobile unlock return could restore the wrong scroll container.
fixed.change: Choose the scrolling container from the actual body position.

fixed.problem: 42px mobile navigation and theme controls; small login, sidebar, and tablet fields can trigger iOS focus zoom.
fixed.change: Use 44px header touch targets and at least 16px editable field text on mobile/touch screens.

fixed.problem: Long native speaker options expand page scroll width in Safari.
Add Organization duplicate checking throws when region input and select share a name.
fixed.change: Attach handlers to each actual control and query only enabled controls.

fixed.problem: Inquiry address fields and map date filters overflow at intermediate widths.
fixed.change: Wrap address rows and reserve enough width for the paired map dates.

fixed.problem: Email preview, record merge, and bulk-task tables expand the whole page.
fixed.change: Contain horizontal scrolling within the relevant preview or table; retain usable merge selectors.

fixed.problem: Next-task due-date pill spills past its card in wide phone landscape.
fixed.change: Allow the pill to wrap within its available width.

results.browser_regression: 16 narrow/tablet mobile layouts, four wide touch layouts, and four desktop checks passed.
other_checks: PHP syntax checks for changed pages

method_notes: Fresh labelled Docker project, isolated database and synthetic records; current source and generated assets.
One-time and POST-only views replayed original server-rendered HTML across sizes without applying destructive actions.
Initial replay artifacts and WebKit navigation-cancellation errors were checked against stable live pages; they were not treated as application defects.
Wide native tables and faithful email previews retain contained horizontal scrolling.
limitations: No physical iPhone or Android device was available.
Native keyboards, OS file/camera pickers, and third-party embedded pages/map tiles were not exercised on hardware.
